advances: Obstruction to the two specified high-level selection rules in the original mixed area. The statements about lifted marks concern their projections and original depth.

proof:
Use b3cc4c9a98fb31d1 on this exact hull. Its middle section is exactly $T$ since $(K_-+K_+)/2=B\subset T$, and its outer sections are the stated endpoints. It gives $a>V>b>0$, $M/2-a=1/4096000$, and, for $e=b/V$, $9/64000\le e<1/6250$. All three fibers are planar convex bodies. Translating the integer bases by one, 2a8c2bc6d7992c5e therefore gives a point of actual depth at least $2M/9$ in this original body.

By the triangle own-depth formula in 431423848c9bacf8, each centroid has ordinary depth $(4/9)|K_z|$, the unique peak (the parallel canonical vertex cap has smaller mass whenever some coordinate exceeds $1/3$). Since $k<2/3$ and own depth is continuous in the fiber, the three relative retained regions have positive area. At a retained point every canonical vertex cap has area at least $k^2|K_z|$, so all barycentric coordinates are at most $1-k=1/3+\delta$. Their sum gives the simultaneous lower bounds $q=1/3-2\delta$.

Use the two fixed closed caps
$$
\{y-2(z+1)\ge (2-s)(8/25)q\},\qquad
\{y+2(z-1)\ge s(8/25)q\}.
$$
All fiber heights are at most one. Each cap therefore isolates its designated endpoint, and covers its entire retained region because the top-vertex barycentric coordinate there is at least $q$. The masses are $(2/3+2\delta)^2a$ and $(2/3+2\delta)^2b$. The larger mass increases over $4a/9$ by $[(8/3)\delta+4\delta^2]a<3\delta<1/9216000$. Here $a<1$ follows from $a<4|B|=64/125$, and $1/9216000=(4/9)(M/2-a)$. Both masses are strictly below $2M/9$.

At the middle fiber take the original cap $\{y+(8/25)(1-s)z\ge h\}$ of b3cc4c9a98fb31d1, where $h=1/3-17e/52$. That fact proves its two endpoint traces are empty and its original mass $V(1-h)^2<2M/9$. It covers the full retained middle region since $y\ge q$ there and $q-h=17e/52-2\delta>0$ by $e\ge9/64000$. The three cap masses are uniform upper bounds for all the retained marks on their respective fibers.

For the absolute level, $a-V=b-2/4096000>1/20000$, using $b\ge V(9/64000)$ and $V=1/2$. Therefore
$$
k^2a-(4/9)V=(4/9)(a-V)-[(4/3)\delta-\delta^2]a>0,
$$
since $a<1$ and $(4/9)/20000>(4/3)\delta$. Thus $k^2a>(4/9)V>(4/9)b$ and the right and middle fibers have no retained marks. The left retained region is its relative level. The largest integer own-depth root is $(2/3)\sqrt a$, as calculated from the three peaks. For either threshold, the projection of all lifted integer marks with $r$ at least that threshold is exactly the described level, because a permitted $r$ exists exactly when the upper endpoint $F_z(x)$ is at least the threshold. The original mass bounds apply to the projected mark for every permitted $r$.

For each triangle, any inner level of positive area is invariant under all affine vertex permutations because both the area ratios and halfspace depth are preserved. Its centroid is fixed by those permutations, so it is the original fiber centroid. Convex combinations of these placed centroids therefore stay in the selector hull whose entire actual trace has depth below $2M/9$ by b3cc4c9a98fb31d1.

statement: Let $T=\operatorname{conv}(0,(1,0),(0,1))$, $B=\operatorname{conv}(0,(4/5,0),(0,8/25))$, $s=3/128+2^{-20}$, and let $C$ be the convex hull of the fibers $K_-=(2-s)B$, $K_0=T$, $K_+=sB$ at bases $-1,0,1$. These are exactly its integer fibers. Let $a=|K_-|$, $V=|T|$, $b=|K_+|$ and $M=a+V+b$. Write $D$ for actual raw mixed depth under summed original area, $f_z$ for ordinary own depth and $F_z=\sqrt{f_z}$. Set $\delta=2^{-30}$, $k=2/3-\delta$ and $\theta=k/(2/3)$. Each of the three relative levels $f_z\ge k^2|K_z|$ has positive area, and every point in their integer trace has $D<2M/9$. The common absolute level $F_z\ge k\sqrt a=\theta\max_{\text{integer }z,x}F_z(x)$ retains only the left fiber, in positive area, and all those points also have $D<2M/9$. In the hypograph $0\le r\le F_z(x)$, every lifted mark at an integer base with $r\ge k\sqrt{|K_z|}$, or with $r\ge k\sqrt a$ respectively, projects to one of these bad points. The unrestricted original body contains a point of depth at least $2M/9$. On this same body, using only the convex hull of the lifted area centroids of any positive-area triangle inner levels also gives $D<2M/9$ at every actual selected mark.
title: Fixed high own-depth levels can exclude every sharp mixed-depth point
